home.super_title:
Welcome to GFork Proxy
a mirror of Greasy Fork
search, install and download — accelerated
home.intro: GFork Proxy is a mirror of Greasy Fork. Requests are relayed through Asia-Pacific servers, so script pages open more reliably and installs and downloads fail less often. We only relay pages and downloads. We don’t write or store any scripts or user data, and content stays in sync with the official site. GFork is not directly affiliated with Greasy Fork. Scripts are published by third parties, so judging their legality and risks is up to you, and we are not responsible for copyright issues or disputes involving them. Pages go through an automated filter, and apart from update links the data matches the official site.
home.recommend: If you’re in mainland China and need scripts that automate study platforms or work with video sites, we recommend downloading from ScriptCat (scriptcat.org). It is run by developers in mainland China as part of the Tampermonkey Chinese Forum (bbs.tampermonkey.net.cn), so community support is better. Note: both the forum and ScriptCat are hosted in Japan.

You must protect personal information and privacy, and must not disclose or misuse other people’s personal information.
tos.section3_3_content: Content: Delete anything you download from the Site within 24 hours. We are not responsible for the legality, safety or suitability of any userscript you download through the Site, and you accept all risks of using it. Features that require human verification, such as publishing scripts, won’t work. Login only takes effect for comments, user features and reporting, and no cookies are sent on other pages. We recommend not using login on any mirror site.
